theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors holds the top momentum rank, remains eligible under the trend gate, shows a trending Hurst regime, moderate durability (0.67), and no crowding. This supports a trend-following overweight, though the gate's historical failure in this market limits confidence.
